COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with elevated D-dimer, ferritin, CRP, and INR, suggesting significant inflammation, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation. Basophilia is present. These findings may indicate severe infection or systemic inflammatory response (e.g., sepsis, severe COVID-19), with risk for bleeding and hypoxic complications. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
